propositions: When re-reviewing a plan with a persisting BLOCK verdict and unchanged description component, a deterministic check should warn (warn-only, not hard-block) if all cited evidence anchors from the blocking findings remain verbatim in the current plan text.
The pre-check must not warn when plan text has changed since the BLOCK, or when cited anchors cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased evidence).
The warning fires only if at least one anchor matched the old text AND all matched anchors are untouched; partial or unmatchable anchors never trigger the warning alone.
The review must execute regardless of warning (no hard decline, no exit-code change, no new flag), preserving the ~8% verdict-flip recovery path.
The precheck.cited_anchor_warning metric (true/false) must be recorded in the sidecar on every plan review to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value.
